description: This file defines the EmailSubscriberService class within the OrangeHRM Admin module. It provides a service layer for handling operations related to email subscribers, mainly managing an internal EmailSubscriberDao data access object instance with a getter method.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberService
classes.description: Service class responsible for email subscriber-related operations, manages a DAO instance.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmailSubscriberDao, creating it if it doesn't already exist.
